an9.9:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] nava ime bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ,
an9.9:1.3: arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmi, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, puthujjano.
an9.9:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, navapuggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
